purpose: Fresh synthetic job review scenarios for the review-only feedback interpretation benchmark.

provenance.authorship: Feedback, employers, posting contexts, and reference judgments were authored for this fixture. The scenarios are fictitious.

reference_rationale.RO3-001: Two complete statements support opposite reactions to distinct duties. Each applies to its own activity, and the selection supplies no additional preference.
reference_rationale.RO3-002: The reviewer gave a genuine reaction but supplied no object for it. A useful follow-up asks what prompted the concern without assuming a reason.
reference_rationale.RO3-003: Leading audits is a clear independent preference. The funding question is a posting detail to check and does not block review of that preference.
reference_rationale.RO3-004: The only expressed concern is uncertainty about a posting fact. Resolve the schedule question before treating the selection as a preference.
reference_rationale.RO3-005: The stated certification belongs in profile fact review. The separate statement about coaching independently supports a preference and stays available for review.
reference_rationale.RO3-006: The reviewer explicitly proposes lowering the confirmed W-2 floor from $75 to $72 per hour for future searches. Route the proposal for separate confirmation. The listing rate is unknown.
reference_rationale.RO3-007: The structured rate and employment type establish a conflict with the approved $100 hourly 1099 minimum. Report that existing violation through fact review and leave the rule untouched.
reference_rationale.RO3-008: The first sentence directly states a general career decision. The second independently preserves interest in a particular duty that could occur in other roles.
reference_rationale.RO3-009: The employer objection and the workload objection stand on their own. The shared title with RO3-008 supplies context but does not justify an additional career signal.
reference_rationale.RO3-010: Remote delivery gates interest in this specific facilitation duty. The condition applies to running the sessions and does not describe a standalone preference about the posting or future jobs.
reference_rationale.RO3-011: The reviewer explicitly accepts a quarterly overnight trip and rejects weekly overnight travel. The limits identify two different scopes for the same work-arrangement feature.
reference_rationale.RO3-012: Preserve the independently supported positive duty and ask about the unresolved reason for rejection. The general concern gives no basis for a negative signal.

provenance.high_risk_routing_selection: Designated before capture. Includes vague feedback, pure verification, a clear preference with a posting verification question, a profile fact with a separate preference, explicit rule confirmation, and a verified eligibility violation.

expected_review_status.PENDING_APPROVAL: Clear preference evidence can enter batch approval; nothing applied.
expected_review_status.PROFILE_FACT_REVIEW: Detected statement about verified facts, existing rules, or a proposed hard-rule change; separate path, not learned automatically.

expected_signal_qualifiers.meaning: Optional material scope details. Use the written feedback and structured job facts that identify the referent. Preserve the stated precision and unit.

schema.expected_signal_condition: Optional condition text for a separate condition on the preference.
schema.reference_notes: Optional reference-only notes about context, verification, or rule evidence.

test_cases.title: Discovery interviews and renewal forecasts
test_cases.original_feedback: I'd be happy to run discovery interviews. I really don't want to own the renewal forecast.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I'd be happy to run discovery interviews
I really don't want to own the renewal forecast

prohibited_inferences: Read the Interested selection as approval of all listed duties.
Expand renewal forecast ownership to all customer success work.

test_cases.title: Unspecified concern
test_cases.original_feedback: Hmm. Something about this one doesn't sit right with me.
prohibited_inferences: Assign the concern to culture, work duties, the employer, or the career category.
test_cases.clarification_question: What part of the opportunity doesn't sit right with you?

reference_notes.evidence_quote: Something about this one doesn't sit right with me

test_cases.title: Accessibility audits with a funding question
test_cases.original_feedback: I'd love to lead the accessibility audits. Can you check whether the position is funded past September?

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I'd love to lead the accessibility audits

prohibited_inferences: Create a funding preference, a job-security rule, or a confirmed funding fact.
Treat the funding question as a condition on the audit preference.

reference_notes.evidence_quote: Can you check whether the position is funded past September?
reference_notes.note: Confirm funding beyond the stated month. No result is established by the feedback.

test_cases.title: Unclear overnight schedule
test_cases.original_feedback: I can't tell from the listing if the overnight shift is once in a while or the usual schedule. Can you find out which?
prohibited_inferences: Read the scheduling question as a dislike of overnight work.
Assert an overnight frequency or a confirmed eligibility conflict.
test_cases.clarification_question: Is the overnight shift a regular part of this job or only occasional?

reference_notes.evidence_quote: I can't tell from the listing if the overnight shift is once in a while or the usual schedule
reference_notes.note: Verify whether overnight duty is regular or occasional.

test_cases.title: Certification and coaching
test_cases.original_feedback: My PMP certification is current. I love coaching new team leads.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I love coaching new team leads

prohibited_inferences: Apply the certification claim as a verified profile update.
Infer a preference for certification requirements or for a career in people management.
test_cases.profile_fact_candidate: The reviewer reports that their PMP certification is current.

reference_notes.note: Current certification is a user-profile claim for review.

test_cases.title: Explicit W-2 minimum change request
test_cases.original_feedback: They haven't posted a rate. Could we lower my W-2 minimum to $72 an hour for future searches?
prohibited_inferences: Apply the new W-2 minimum from this feedback.
Treat $72 per hour as the posting rate or alter any other pay minimum.
Learn a compensation-transparency preference from the first sentence.
test_cases.profile_fact_candidate: The reviewer asks to lower the W-2 minimum to $72 per hour for future searches. Separate explicit rule confirmation is required.

reference_notes.note: No offered hourly rate is established.

reference_notes.evidence_quote: Could we lower my W-2 minimum to $72 an hour for future searches?
reference_notes.note: A proposed change to a confirmed rule requires separate confirmation.

test_cases.title: Confirmed 1099 rate below the existing floor
test_cases.original_feedback: They confirmed $94 an hour on a 1099. That's below my existing $100 minimum.
prohibited_inferences: Learn a new compensation preference or minimum.
Treat the existing threshold as a proposed change.
test_cases.profile_fact_candidate: The confirmed 1099 rate of $94 per hour is below the existing $100 hourly minimum.

reference_notes.evidence_quote: They confirmed $94 an hour on a 1099. That's below my existing $100 minimum
reference_notes.note: The structured rate and employment type verify this existing policy conflict.

test_cases.title: Leaving product operations as a career
test_cases.original_feedback: I'm done pursuing product operations as a career. I do still like planning launch rehearsals.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I'm done pursuing product operations as a career
I do still like planning launch rehearsals

prohibited_inferences: Infer that the reviewer dislikes this employer or the launch rehearsal duty.
Expand the career preference to all product roles.

test_cases.title: Employer and workload objections
test_cases.original_feedback: I wouldn't apply to Cairnquill Systems again. And I don't want to spend all day reconciling release checklists.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I wouldn't apply to Cairnquill Systems again
I don't want to spend all day reconciling release checklists

prohibited_inferences: Infer a product operations career downgrade from the posting title.
Expand an all-day workload objection to any time spent on a release checklist.

test_cases.title: Remote facilitation of planning sessions
test_cases.original_feedback: I'd be interested in facilitating the planning sessions, but only if I can run them remotely.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I'd be interested in facilitating the planning sessions, but only if I can run them remotely
expected_interpretations.condition: only if I can run them remotely

prohibited_inferences: Learn a general remote-work preference.
Record unconditional interest in facilitating the planning sessions.

test_cases.title: Quarterly and weekly overnight travel
test_cases.original_feedback: One overnight trip a quarter works for me. Weekly overnight travel would be a dealbreaker.

expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: One overnight trip a quarter works for me
Weekly overnight travel would be a dealbreaker

prohibited_inferences: Generalize to all overnight travel or all travel.
Convert a strongly expressed review preference into a confirmed hard rule.

test_cases.title: Clear intake duty with unresolved concern
test_cases.original_feedback: I like the chance to build the intake process from scratch. The rest of the job gives me pause, but I can't put my finger on why.

expected_interpretations.feature: building an intake process from scratch
expected_interpretations.evidence_quote: I like the chance to build the intake process from scratch

prohibited_inferences: Turn the unspecified concern into a negative preference for a particular duty, this employer, or the career category.
Drop the supported positive reaction to building an intake process from scratch.
test_cases.clarification_question: What about the rest of this job gives you pause?

reference_notes.evidence_quote: The rest of the job gives me pause, but I can't put my finger on why
reference_notes.note: The concern is material to the reaction and the object remains unspecified.
